answer: Commit-reveal receipts are forfeited the moment a duplicate submission appears, which is the failure mode that kills lazy farms first, and the quorum that validates them must span unrelated subnetworks, so one hosting provider cannot supply the whole panel. The tide of a fast launch turns into a marble of frozen stake once two clones post the same payload. A prism splits one answer into many visible copies, and every copy is a signature the operator cannot retract.
